Looking at this position, **Rd7** is the clearly best move—a devastating rook sacrifice that forces checkmate.

After **Rd7**, Black's rook is pinned (if it moves, Rc7 mates on c7 with the king having no escape on f6). Black must recapture **Rxd7**, then **Rc7** threatens unstoppable back rank mate. Black has no defense.

**Coaching Note:**
Always scan for back rank weaknesses in positions with restricted kings. When your opponent has limited escape squares, sacrifices that remove defenders and create mating nets can be decisive. Here, Rd7 exploits Black's trapped king on f6 and weak back rank. Look for forcing moves that cut off escape squares!
